limitations: The retained portal metadata marks each regular-primary election's results official and production, but no separate signed statewide certification instrument is retained and bound to the workbook bytes.

Only each workbook's Total Votes sheet is parsed. Total Votes by Group and precinct or county sheets are not added again, and separately published runoff election events are not retained or assessed in this package.
The workbooks do not mark winners. Vote rank, a one-candidate contest, and the source (I) label are not converted into a winner, nominee, runoff-advancement, or current-member identity conclusion.

The 2022 source observation for current GA-06 is source district 07. That bounded source-name observation is not a claim of current identity approval or historical-to-current geographic compatibility.
Georgia Secretary of State reuse terms do not state an open-data license for these files, so this reviewer-only receipt records licenseOrReuseTerms as not_stated_by_source.
